result.reason: The file conforms to all three test conventions. Subject framing: the top-level describe names the unit under test ('awards', the module under test), nested describes use 'when' clauses, and each it reads as a sentence with describe + it. One assertion per block: every it contains exactly one expect, and compound shapes are asserted once via toMatchObject. Functionality, not implementation: tests exercise only public APIs (pickWinners, createReview's run, and the honest in-memory memory store), assert on returned values only, use no spies or mocks, and build data fresh in beforeEach setup with no cross-suite dependencies.
